claims.claim: Great condition with powerful clean sound
claims.evidence: No audio/video evidence; photos show only static views of front and base plate, no sound can be judged from stills.

claims.claim: Can be used with your laptop or other devices
claims.evidence: No clip showing active use or connection to a device.
Buttons and knob are visible in Photo 1 but no demonstration of function is shown.
No power adapter is visible in any of the three photos.
No receipt, box, or UK plug/adapter shown; origin claim cannot be checked from photos.
Requires live audio test; photos cannot show sound quality.

risks.risk: Bluetooth function may not work despite branding on base plate
risks.proof: Short video showing phone pairing with the speaker and audio playing over Bluetooth

risks.risk: Internal driver damage causing crackle or dead channel
risks.proof: Video clip of unit playing audio at moderate/high volume from both left and right units
risks.if_unproven: price as for a unit with suspected driver/crackle fault

risks.risk: Missing power adapter or aux cable despite seller's claim
risks.proof: Photo of the power adapter and aux cable laid out next to the speakers
risks.if_unproven: price as speakers only, no accessories

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic damage on rear/sides/base not shown
risks.proof: Additional photos of rear, sides, and underside of both speaker units
risks.if_unproven: price as average cosmetic condition, not 'great condition'

risks.risk: Buttons/knob may be unresponsive or intermittent
risks.proof: Video demonstrating volume knob, headphone jack button, and power button all responding correctly

risks.risk: Unknown age/usage history affecting component wear
risks.proof: Any UK purchase receipt, box with date code, or serial number cross-check

proof_requests: Video of speakers playing audio (wired) at moderate/high volume
Video of Bluetooth pairing and playback
Photo of included power adapter and any cables
Photos of rear and sides of both speaker units
Video demonstrating all buttons and the volume knob functioning
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a Logitech Z207 speaker set from the base plate, so pricing is possible, but condition, accessory completeness, and all functional claims remain unverified and must be priced at worst case until proof is supplied.
